def analyze(k):
    gi,go=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    for r in range(H):
        irow=[gi[r][c] for c in range(W)]; orow=[go[r][c] for c in range(W)]
        runs=[]; c=0
        while c<W:
            if orow[c]!=irow[c]:
                start=c
                while c<W and orow[c]!=irow[c]: c+=1
                runs.append((start,c-1,orow[start],irow[start]))
            else: c+=1
        print(k,'row',r,'runs:',runs)

def paint2(g):  # center = nonzero with >=2 orthogonal neighbors; paint full row+col on original zeros only, in order: columns then rows
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cs=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W)
        if g[i][j]!=0 and sum(1 for d,e in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]
                               if 0<=i+d<H and 0<=j+e<W and g[i+d][j+e]!=0)>=2]
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    for _,j,v in sorted(cs,key=lambda x:x[0]):
        for r in range(H):
            if o[r][j]==0: o[r][j]=v
    return o
